safety_context.summary: Domain A reports an integrity-related safety event, but the originating trace reference is missing.

recommended_response.reason: Domain B should review the alert only after provenance can be validated.

local_processing.interpretation: The source domain and event are declared, but DOMAIN-B cannot reconstruct or verify the originating safety history because origin_trace_id is missing.

violations.name: Safety Signal Provenance Missing
violations.reason: The signal does not include origin_trace_id, so the originating safety event cannot be independently reconstructed from trace.

SAFETY-INV-041.reason: DOMAIN-A and DOMAIN-B have explicit and distinct domain and authority boundaries.

SAFETY-INV-042.reason: No remote authority is accepted or propagated into DOMAIN-B.

SAFETY-INV-043.reason: The signal lacks origin_trace_id and therefore does not provide sufficient provenance for trusted cross-domain safety propagation.

SAFETY-INV-044.reason: DOMAIN-B locally interprets the incomplete signal and holds it for review instead of directly acting on it.

SAFETY-INV-045.reason: No remote containment is applied in DOMAIN-B.

SAFETY-INV-046.reason: The signal does not create shared execution authority.

SAFETY-INV-047.reason: Propagation is explicitly bounded by destination, expiry, TTL, and forwarding limits.

SAFETY-INV-048.reason: Replay checking was performed and no replay or context substitution was detected.

SAFETY-INV-049.reason: DOMAIN-B retains independent control over any future recovery decision.

risk.reason: Without an origin trace reference, receivers cannot reliably verify how the safety claim was produced or whether supporting evidence belongs to the declared event.

required_actions: reject the signal as trusted federated safety evidence
do not act solely on the untraceable safety claim
request a valid origin_trace_id or equivalent trace reference
verify that the trace belongs to EVENT-A-043 and DOMAIN-A
re-evaluate provenance after the missing trace is supplied
preserve the provenance failure in DOMAIN-B local trace
